fact.title: muscle:grep--r-ls
fact.body:
### Context
The same 3-command sequence was observed 2× in this session (shadow-worker repetition detection).

### Steps
- grep -r "ask" D:/01_programovani/pi/plugins/pi-uma/src/ --include="*.ts" | head -30
- ls -la D:/01_programovani/pi/plugins/pi-uma/src/slices/
- grep -r "1c" D:/01_programovani/pi/plugins/pi-uma/ --include="*.md" --include="*.ts" --include="*.rs" | head -20
- grep -r "/uma" D:/01_programovani/pi/plugins/pi-uma/src/slices/commands/ --include="*.ts" | head -30
- ls -la D:/01_programovani/pi/plugins/pi-uma/src/slices/tools/ 2>/dev/null || echo "No tools slice"
- grep -r '"ask"' D:/01_programovani/pi/plugins/pi-uma/src/ --include="*.ts" | head -20

### Rule
Run the sequence as one motor chunk with `uma muscle run grep--r-ls --confirm`.
